1: // Canvas Runner – simple endless runner
2: // Target canvas with id="game"
3: 
4: (() => {
5:   const canvas = document.getElementById('game');
6:   if (!canvas) return console.error('Canvas with id "game" not found');
7:   const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
8:   const { width, height } = canvas;
9: 
10:   // Player
11:   const player = {
12:     w: 30,
13:     h: 30,
14:     x: width / 2 - 15,
15:     y: height - 40,
16:     speed: 5,
17:     moveLeft: false,
18:     moveRight: false,
19:   };
20: 
21:   // Obstacles
22:   const obstacles = [];
23:   const obstacleWidth = 40;
24:   const obstacleHeight = 20;
25:   const obstacleSpeed = 2;
26:   let obstacleTimer = 0;
27:   const obstacleInterval = 90; // frames
28: 
29:   // Score
30:   let score = 0;
31: 
32:   // Input handling
33:   const keyDown = (e) => {
34:     if (e.key === 'ArrowLeft' || e.key === 'a') player.moveLeft = true;
35:     if (e.key === 'ArrowRight' || e.key === 'd') player.moveRight = true;
36:   };
37:   const keyUp = (e) => {
38:     if (e.key === 'ArrowLeft' || e.key === 'a') player.moveLeft = false;
39:     if (e.key === 'ArrowRight' || e.key === 'd') player.moveRight = false;
40:   };
41:   window.addEventListener('keydown', keyDown);
42:   window.addEventListener('keyup', keyUp);
43: 
44:   const resetGame = () => {
45:     player.x = width / 2 - player.w / 2;
46:     player.y = height - 40;
47:     obstacles.length = 0;
48:     score = 0;
49:     obstacleTimer = 0;
50:   };
51: 
52:   const spawnObstacle = () => {
53:     const x = Math.random() * (width - obstacleWidth);
54:     obstacles.push({ x, y: -obstacleHeight, w: obstacleWidth, h: obstacleHeight });
55:   };
56: 
57:   const rectsCollide = (a, b) =>
58:     a.x < b.x + b.w && a.x + a.w > b.x && a.y < b.y + b.h && a.y + a.h > b.y;
59: 
60:   const update = () => {
61:     // Move player
62:     if (player.moveLeft) player.x = Math.max(0, player.x - player.speed);
63:     if (player.moveRight) player.x = Math.min(width - player.w, player.x + player.speed);
64: 
65:     // Spawn obstacles
66:     if (obstacleTimer <= 0) {
67:       spawnObstacle();
68:       obstacleTimer = obstacleInterval;
69:     } else {
70:       obstacleTimer--;
71:     }
72: 
73:     // Update obstacles
74:     for (let i = obstacles.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
75:       const o = obstacles[i];
76:       o.y += obstacleSpeed;
77:       // Remove off‑screen obstacles and increase score
78:       if (o.y > height) {
79:         obstacles.splice(i, 1);
80:         score++;
81:       } else if (rectsCollide(player, o)) {
82:         // Game over
83:         alert('Game Over! Score: ' + score);
84:         resetGame();
85:         break;
86:       }
87:     }
88:   };
89: 
90:   const draw = () => {
91:     ctx.clearRect(0, 0, width, height);
92:     // Draw player
93:     ctx.fillStyle = '#0a84ff';
94:     ctx.fillRect(player.x, player.y, player.w, player.h);
95:     // Draw obstacles
96:     ctx.fillStyle = '#ff3b30';
97:     obstacles.forEach(o => ctx.fillRect(o.x, o.y, o.w, o.h));
98:     // Draw score
99:     ctx.fillStyle = '#000';
100:     ctx.font = '16px sans-serif';
101:     ctx.fillText('Score: ' + score, 10, 20);
102:   };
103: 
104:   const loop = () => {
105:     update();
106:     draw();
107:     requestAnimationFrame(loop);
108:   };
109: 
110:   // Start the game loop
111:   loop();
112: })();
